better-sg-reports.js.description: This script creates a comprehensive, branded dashboard for analyzing and visualizing SiteGround hosting metrics. It helps users interpret server health, site performance, and the effect of optimizations through charts, metrics, and detailed reports.
usage: Visit any SiteGround site and run the script as a browser bookmarklet.
It intercepts API responses from SiteGround's management console to gather data.
It opens a custom overlay interface where you can view reports, generate PDFs, export CSVs, and compare metrics before and after site fixes.
Ensure pop-ups are allowed, as the dashboard opens in new tabs to display reports and data visualizations.

ie-extractor.js.description: This script creates a floating image extractor panel on any page, which collects all images, detects if they are from iStock, and displays them in a sortable table. You can filter images by filename, alt text, or iStock ID, select images, and download their files directly. It enhances image management without altering page content permanently.
usage: Run the bookmarklet while on a page with images to activate the extractor panel.
Click the 🖼 Images FAB button to show/hide the panel.
Use the search box or filters to find specific images by filename, alt, or iStock ID.
Click download options in the panel to save selected images.
